description.zh: 管理 X、LinkedIn、Facebook、Instagram、YouTube、小红书、抖音、B 站、知乎账号：浏览器方式照常使用，Facebook 公共主页可选官方 API 通道；把内容改写成帖子，审核后发布或排期，定时采集互动数据和粉丝数。
description.en: Manage X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili and Zhihu accounts: keep the browser channel and optionally use the official API for Facebook Pages; rewrite, review, publish or schedule posts, and collect engagement and follower data.
